The job depends on the money choice you pick: the phone screen, a computer priced at the visit, or a laptop screen priced from photos.

notes:
From auto-repair (from: auto-repair): a device repair shop runs like a car repair shop. The device is dropped off, a diagnosis fee is OK'd, a written estimate is OK'd before any work, a part is ordered, and READY comes before the pick-up.
Checked the old flowchart first: a phone, tablet and computer repair shop (Wasatch Device Repair), dropped off or mailed in. That fits this profession.
Two companies: Lee Tech Help (the master's Lee Home Services, flow B: on-site repair at homes and offices, plus network setup) and Lee's Device Repair (the master's barbershop, flow A: the shop). Kinds of work: plumbing became on-site repair, electrical became network setup, the barbershop became the device repair shop.
People: Riley and Avery became Tyler and Nina (the shop); Jordan and Casey became Ethan and Priya (on-site), so the master's pronouns still fit (Jordan he, Casey she). Sofia's drop-off example became Alex's. Addresses: 240 Market St (the shop), 18 Cedar Ave (Alex), 600 Pine St (the office).
Licenses: a repair dealer registration where the state or city registers repair dealers (the company and the shop), and a low-voltage license for network installers where the state requires one. Repair technicians need none. S1-60, S1-63 and S2-28 keep both branches (state by state; installers vs technicians). Named states and cities in the old sheet became generic switches.
Flow A money: main visit|none|counter, a laptop that won't hold a charge. The $49 diagnosis counts toward the repair; the estimate is a $110 battery and a $15 fan cleaning, $125 with the diagnosis (OK some lines: $110). The battery is ordered with the yes and comes Tue Oct 27; READY Tue 3:15pm, pick-up 5:30pm, paid at the counter.
Flow A also: list|none|counter and list|none|bill ($35 computer tune-up; the bill goes with READY), visit|none|bill (the laptop repair, bill with READY), list|deposit|counter ($140 Chromebook screen, a $40 deposit orders the part, $100 at the counter). The shop saves no card, holds nothing and takes no full price: it charges no cancel or no-show fee.
Flow B money: main list|hold|bill, a $179 phone screen at Alex's home with the $89 on-site fee held. visit|hold|bill: a computer priced at the visit ($245: a $165 SSD with the files copied and an $80 memory upgrade; some lines $165). list|hold|card: the saved card charged at DONE. photos|deposit|bill: a $640 laptop screen priced from photos, Sam OKs it, a $160 deposit (25%) orders the part, $480 on the bill. No full price anywhere.
Sign-up words follow how this work is paid (S1-13, S1-16, S1-17, S1-42, S1-45, S1-46, S1-47, S11-56, S11-57): no service is paid in full; virus removal holds the on-site fee; the shop takes nothing, a deposit only for a part ordered in, no fees. The shop's tune-up at home is $124 ($35 plus the $89 on-site fee), with the fee held, so the master's $75 became $124.
Clocks on the visit path move past Saturday: A8-29 Sat 12:20pm (the yes orders the battery), A8-43 Tue 2:30pm, A8-50 3:15pm, A8-54 5:30pm, A10-02 7pm, A9-04 Tue, A9-10 Sat Oct 31, A10-32 Thu Oct 29. The WAITING ON A PART news rides on the estimate's yes, so A8-11 has no message that would run the clock back.
Own steps: the mail-in branch on A4-01 (A4-x01 to A4-x03), the data consent and passcode on the counter tablet (A8-x01, A8-x02), the diagnosis hour (A8-x03 to A8-x05), the new part failing its test (A8-x06) and the passcode deleted at pick-up (A8-x07).
Flow B is on-site repair at a home or office. The old flowchart's other side is a mail-in, which is a drop-off and so a branch of flow A. A laptop that needs board repair goes to Lee Tech Help's workbench and comes back on a booked return (B8-38, B8-72 kept).
Never sent now: S2-30, B4-81, B7-55, B8-58 and B6-03's sent-now branch are off; a swollen battery gets the safety steps and the soonest time. Nobody needs to be home is off (someone hands over and unlocks the device). The place's owner (B4-78) and the landlord branches are off: nothing is built into a home.
Off as work this shop never has: plans and insurance in flow A (A4-28, A4-54, A5-01, A7-02's plan branches, A9-15), rented items (A10-06, B10-07), the next visit at checkout (A10-06), a day-before hold (A7-02), an expert's read (A6-01, B6-03), the live line (B3-01) and weather (A7-02, B7-05).
